title: BK-Score dataset: evidence ratings for 520 supplements, peptides and biohacking practices
description:
Evidence ratings for 520 supplements, peptides and experimental drugs, treatments and diagnostics, lifestyle practices and Khavinson bioregulator peptides. Each entry is rated on five axes from 0 to 10 (human evidence, mechanism, safety data, hype gap, track record of use) with a written rationale (German) and a link to an entry page listing all sources. Key figures: 37 entries (7.1 %) well supported; 102 (19.6 %) never studied in humans or marketed far ahead of the evidence; 264 (50.8 %) with a hype gap of 3 or less out of 10.

Subjective assessment by Biohacking Kompakt based on published rating rules (https://biohackingkompakt.de/methodik.html). Not a medical recommendation.
